page_title: ROM 1-3 BOL | AS Roma v Bologna 22/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Santiago Castro (Bologna) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.

90+2' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
90+1' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Santiago Castro (Bologna) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) probably handled the ball. Bologna are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.

86' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
85' That will be all from Bryan Cristante who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Joao Costa (AS Roma).
85' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
84' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
83' None of the AS Roma players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
83' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
80' It's time for a substitution. Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) comes on in place of Dan Ndoye.
80' The substitution is prepared. Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Stefan Posch.
80' Substitution. Riccardo Calafiori will be replaced by Victor Kristiansen (Bologna).
77' Thiago Motta has decided to substitute Oussama El Azzouzi and he is replaced by Kacper Urbanski (Bologna).
74' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
73' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Fabio Maresca has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Bologna earn a free kick.
72' Daniele De Rossi prepares a substitution. Stephan El Shaarawy is replaced by Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma).
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Santiago Castro (Bologna) comes onto the pitch so that Joshua Zirkzee can be given a rest.
68' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) takes the corner which is cleared.

68' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bologna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
67' The resulting set piece from AS Roma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
65' 1 - 3 What a goal that is! Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) gets to the ball inside the box and brilliantly lifts the ball over Mile Svilar and into the net. 1:3.
64' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
64' Fabio Maresca shows a yellow card to Remo Freuler (Bologna) for a tough tackle.
63' The main referee, Fabio Maresca, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Diego Llorente (AS Roma) is given a yellow card for dissent.
63' Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna) commits a rough challenge and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul. AS Roma win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
61' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
61' Bologna are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
59' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle as Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. There is a free kick near the sideline to Bologna.
58' A pass from Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is intercepted by Lukasz Skorupski and the move breaks down.
56' 1 - 2 Goal! Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.
55' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AS Roma.
52' Substitution. Angelino makes way for Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma).
52' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
52' Here is a change. Zeki Celik is going off and Daniele De Rossi gives the last tactical orders to Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma).
52' Substitution. Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) in, Tammy Abraham out.
52' Stefan Posch (Bologna) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
51' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
50' The corner is swung in but AS Roma can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
50' Tammy Abraham (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
48' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Bologna is cautioned for aggressive play. AS Roma are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
46' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' 0 - 2 Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
43' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Fabio Maresca blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to AS Roma.

42' OFF THE BAR! Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) strikes a brilliant shot towards goal from the free kick, but his effort rattles the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
40' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) sees a yellow card from Fabio Maresca after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
40' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle and it's Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Bologna are awarded a free kick.
37' Bologna are ruled offside.

37' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) misses a big chance! He fires the ball high over the crossbar from inside the 6-yard box after the ball rebounded to him. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
37' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) takes the corner but it's cleared.
36' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
33' Fabio Maresca shows the yellow card to Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) for a heavy challenge.
31' Remo Freuler (Bologna) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Fabio Maresca saw the whole situation. It's a free kick to AS Roma, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
30' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bologna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
29' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Bologna are awarded the free kick.
28' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
26' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
25' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
24' The referee blows his whistle, AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
22' Stefan Posch (Bologna) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
22' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
21' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
20' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
17' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Leandro Paredes (AS Roma).
14' 0 - 1 GOAL! Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna) scores in ugly fashion, sending the ball into the net via a miscued scissor kick direct from a lofted ball into the box. It’s 0:1.
13' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bologna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
13' The foul by Angelino (AS Roma) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Fabio Maresca.
11' A crossfield pass from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) fails to find any of his teammates.

9' CHANCE! Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
8' Dangerous play by Sam Beukema (Bologna). Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to AS Roma in a dangerous position.
6' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) gets a yellow card.
6' Fabio Maresca shows a yellow card to Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
5' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) was too forceful with his tackle and Fabio Maresca interrupted the game to signal a free kick. That's a free kick to AS Roma.

3' Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
2' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Bologna will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Fabio Maresca.
